We'd love to see the perspective of more protocol level researchers. This is going to be immensely helpful in shaping our next 6 months and beyond: thanks in advance. Plus if you complete, there are some nice prizes:

-  ✈️  1 of 3 free return flights to an ETHGlobal event
- 🎟️ 1 of 2 free tickets to Devcon 6
